newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Great Central says no Barrick bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Great Central says no Barrick bid.

text.p: Great Central Mines Ltd said on Friday it had not received a takeover bid from Barrick Gold Corp and was unaware of any plans for a bid.
Barrick, responding to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange about continuing media talk of a bid from the Canadian company, said it was its policy not to comment on speculation.
"However, the company reiterates that it has not received nor is it aware of a takeover bid from Barrick Gold Corporation," Barrick said.

"Specifically, the chairman, Mr Joseph Gutnick, refutes as false and misleading any implications in the article ... in The Australian today of any background briefing whatsoever by Mr Gutnick outlining the terms and possible timing of a bid."

The Australian article, by columnist Mark Westfield, said Gutnick, who holds 20 percent of Great Central, gave an off-the-record briefing at a recent mining conference in which he discussed the terms and probable timing of a bid.
The stock exchange noted that Great Central had said on two previous occasions that it had not received a bid from Barrick and was not aware of plans for a bid.
However, the exchange requested that the company make a further announcement in light of the continuing speculation.
It said it was particularly concerned about comments attributed to Gutnick at the mining conference.
"We request that the announcement makes the chairman's position clear," the exchange said.
Great Central shares were four cents weaker at A$2.48 at 12.45 p.m. (0240 GMT) after earlier touching a high of A$2.50.
